name: PALB2
summary: Germline PALB2 pathogenic variants are a high-penetrance breast cancer susceptibility factor and confer homologous recombination deficiency with emerging evidence of PARP inhibitor sensitivity.
biology: PALB2 (partner and localiser of BRCA2) bridges BRCA1 and BRCA2 at sites of DNA damage, enabling BRCA2-mediated RAD51 loading and homologous recombination. Biallelic loss in tumours produces a BRCA-like phenotype.
alterations: Germline pathogenic or likely pathogenic PALB2 variants

testing.specimen: Peripheral blood or saliva for germline testing; tumour tissue for somatic testing
testing.notes: Genetic counselling and cascade testing are recommended.

predictiveRelevance: Phase II data have shown activity of olaparib in metastatic breast cancer with germline PALB2 pathogenic variants; it is not a uniformly labelled indication and use depends on jurisdiction and guideline endorsement.
resistance: Reversion mutations restoring PALB2 function (analogous to BRCA reversions)
